coach_curl_keep_elbows_still.text: Keep your elbows pinned to your sides. Don't let them drift forward.

coach_curl_reduce_swing.text: Stop using momentum. Let your biceps do the work.

coach_curl_slow_eccentric.text: Slow down the lowering. Take two seconds to bring it back down.

coach_press_stay_tall.text: Sit up tall. Don't lean back as you press up.

coach_press_symmetric.text: Press both dumbbells up together. Keep them even.

coach_press_full_range.text: Bring the weights down a bit more before your next press.

coach_raise_shoulder_height.text: That's high enough. Stop at shoulder height and control it down.

coach_raise_steady_body.text: Keep your torso still. Use a smooth, controlled motion.

coach_raise_slow_down.text: Slow it down. Quality over speed.

coach_row_steady_chest.text: Keep your chest facing forward. Don't rotate with the weight.

coach_row_elbow_to_hip.text: Drive your elbow back toward your hip, not out to the side.

coach_row_slow_lowering.text: Control the weight on the way down. Don't drop it.

coach_switch_side.text: Good. Now switch to the other side.

coach_pose_lost.text: I can't see you clearly. Move back to the center of the frame.

coach_round_improvement.text: Looking much steadier this round. Keep it up.

seated_dumbbell_curl.intro: Seated Dumbbell Curl. Keep your back against the bench and elbows pinned to your sides. Curl up with control, lower slowly. 10 reps.
key_points: Elbows stay fixed at your sides
Lower the weight slowly on each rep

seated_dumbbell_shoulder_press.intro: Seated Shoulder Press. Sit tall, press both dumbbells straight up. Lower them back to shoulder height with control. 8 reps.
key_points: Keep your back straight, don't lean back
Full range: down to shoulders, up to near straight

seated_dumbbell_lateral_raise.intro: Seated Lateral Raise. Raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height. Keep your body still. 8 reps.
key_points: Stop at shoulder height, no higher
Keep your torso still, no leaning

supported_dumbbell_row.intro: Supported Dumbbell Row. Hold the bench with one hand, row the dumbbell up by driving your elbow back toward your hip. Keep your chest steady. 8 reps each side.
key_points: Keep your chest facing forward, don't rotate
Drive elbow back toward your hip
Lower with control, don't drop the weight

seated_arm_circle.intro: Let's warm up. Small arm circles, 30 seconds. Get your shoulders moving.

seated_scapular_retraction.intro: Now squeeze your shoulder blades together. Pull them back and hold for a moment, then release. 8 reps.
